auth.why: To act on the user's 401(k) analysis: compute match capture, save billing for the annual fee, and deliver the fix plan.

description: Finds uncaptured employer 401(k) match from salary, contribution rate, and match formula, then delivers a step-by-step contribution fix plan. Flat $99/year.

proactive_triggers.description: New job detected: offer letter, 'I started a new job', or job_change bus event
proactive_triggers.event: job_change — new job means a new 401(k); most people leave match money on the table in year one
proactive_triggers.nudge: New job, new 401(k). Most people leave free match money on the table in year one. Tell me your salary and contribution % and I'll check yours in 30 seconds.

tools.description: Start the conversational intake (golden path): returns the first question to ask verbatim
tools.name: start_draft

tools.description: Answer the current draft question; returns the next question or the finished payoff summary
tools.name: answer_draft

tools.description: Create a 401(k) match analysis plan from salary, pay frequency, current contribution %, and employer match formula (advanced path)
tools.name: create_plan

tools.description: Get a plan's summary: uncaptured match dollars, current vs max match, paid status
tools.name: get_plan_summary

tools.description: Set up billing: create the Stripe customer and return a SetupIntent client_secret to save a card (no charge yet)
tools.name: setup_billing

tools.description: Charge the flat $99/year fee off-session against the saved card; unlocks the fix pack
tools.name: pay_fee

tools.description: Get the full fix plan: recommended contribution %, per-paycheck dollars, and change steps (requires paid fee)
tools.name: get_fix_pack

tools.description: Return the educational-use disclaimer (not financial advice)
tools.name: disclaimer
